reply.thought: Need to verify refunds are completed; then compute each customer net balance via tool and record one payout per customer. Start by listing orders/refunds to identify customers in this batch.
Orders list received. Need to ensure refunds correspond to these customers/orders and then fetch net balances per customer using net_balance tool before recording payouts.
Refunds match the batch-provided list and correspond to orders 161,163,164. Proceed to compute net balance per affected customer (acme, birch) using net_balance tool; cobalt has no refunds so far.
acme net balance retrieved. Next get net balance for birch and cobalt, then record one payout per customer for those net cents.
Now fetch net balance for cobalt. Then record payouts for acme, birch, and cobalt (net balances represent order minus refunds).

Refunds are reported applied and match the batch refund requests (orders 161,163,164). Net balances fetched for all customers in this batch: acme 46023, birch 1461, cobalt 35816. Proceed to record one payout per customer for these net cents.
Payout for acme recorded. Now record payout for birch net balance, then cobalt.
Payout for birch recorded. Now record payout for cobalt net balance.
All required payouts recorded once per customer using net_balance results. Refund work appears complete and consistent with the batch refund list.
